newsitem.title: HONG KONG: JAL/Air France to launch more code share flights.
newsitem.headline: JAL/Air France to launch more code share flights.

text.p: Japan Airlines and Air France will inaugurate a new, twice weekly code-share flight between Nagoya and Paris from July 1, a JAL press statement said.

The non stop Airbus A340-300 service, which is subject to government approval, will provide more convenient service between central Japan and Paris contributing to the strengthening of commercial and cultural links.

The Nagoya-Paris flight is the latest development in cooperation between the two flag carriers. In June 1995, the carriers signed a wide-ranging business cooperation agreement which included linking frequent flyer programmes.

The airlines already operate code share flights daily between Osaka and Paris and four times weekly between Tokyo and Noumea. Another code share flight between Paris and Istanbul is scheduled to begin next month, the JAL statement said.
